svg.desc: Three rising steps. Linear probe: frozen encoder, embeddings computed once, about 3,000 trained parameters. LoRA with rank 8: adapters on the query and value projections plus a new head, 741 thousand trained parameters and 263 MB of state. Full fine-tuning: all 67 million parameters and about 1 GB of state before activations.
